nodes.question: What are some opportunities provided by food nanotechnology for sustainable food production?
nodes.answer: Food nanotechnology offers opportunities to enhance sustainable food production through the development of nano-enabled sensors, improving pesticide and fertilizer performance, and remediating contaminated soils.
